sentences.text: Eociconia is an extinct genus of birds classified as a primitive stork. It stands as one of the earliest known members of the order Ciconiiformes.
The genus Eociconia was described by Hou in 1989. The type species of the genus is Eociconia sangequanensis.
The holotype fossil of Eociconia is a metatarsus found in the Yixibaila Formation in Xinjiang, China.
Eociconia lived during the Eocene period.
